q: A ball attached to a string is whirled around a vertical circle. At the bottom of the circle, _____. (2026)
a: it has a net force acting upward,
it has a net force acting downward
e: At the bottom of a vertical circle, the net force acts upward toward the center to provide the centripetal acceleration.

q: Centripetal force of _____ is required to move a body of mass 2 kg with a speed of 1 ms⁻¹ in a uniform circular motion of radius 5 m. (2026)
One of the centripetal forces is _____. (2025)
e: Tension force can act as a centripetal force when an object is whirled on a string.

q: The normal force F_N exerted by a banked road is _____ to the road. (2026)
e: Normal force is always perpendicular to the surface of contact.

q: What is the magnitude of the centripetal force of an object of mass m moving along a circle of radius r with angular speed ω? (2026)
e: The magnitude of centripetal force expressed in terms of angular speed is F = mrω².

q: When a car in motion takes a sudden turn in a curve path passengers in the car experience _____. (2026)
e: Due to inertia, passengers experience an apparent outward push during a sudden curve turn.

q: The electric force acting on an electron orbiting the nucleus is _____ force. (2025)
e: The electrostatic attraction between the electron and nucleus acts as the required centripetal force.

q: Which force is essential on a banked road? (2025)
e: Centripetal force is necessary for any vehicle negotiating a curve safely.

q: Centrifugal pump is a hydraulic machine which works by the use of _____ force acting on the fluid. (2026)
e: A centrifugal pump uses centrifugal force created by rotating impellers to move fluid outward.

q: When a car turns in a circular path or a curve, a _____ exists between the road and the car tires. (2025)
e: Frictional force between tires and the road surface provides the necessary centripetal force.

q: Limitting speed of a car to turn successfully the banked road depends on the _____. (2025)
e: The safe limiting speed on a banked road depends on the banking angle and curve radius, independent of vehicle mass.

q: Centrifugal pump converts mechanical energy into _____ energy. (2025)
e: Centrifugal pumps convert rotational mechanical power into hydraulic energy in the fluid.

q: Centrifugal pump converts mechanical energy into _____ energy by the use of centrifugal force acting on the fluid. (2026)
e: The pump utilizes centrifugal force to convert mechanical energy into hydraulic fluid energy.

q: A cyclist moves along a curved track. To avoid slipping, the cyclist must _____. (2026)
e: Leaning inward provides a horizontal component of normal force that acts as centripetal force to prevent slipping.

q: Which statement correctly applies Newton's third law to the centripetal force provided by a rope pulling a ball in a circle? (2026)
a: the reaction force is the force the ball exerts on the hand, directed outward
the reaction force is the centrifugal force acting on the ball
the reaction force is the gravitational force on the ball
e: According to Newton's third law, the reaction to the inward centripetal force on the ball is an equal outward force exerted by the ball on the hand.
